title: Wiki - process description for translation
symptom: Users want to contribute translations but do not know the process or how to use their translated version.
cause: There is no documentation describing the translation process.
fix: Create a PR against CONTRIBUTING.md that briefly describes the translation process (Crowdin account, translation, approval, automatic merging to jamorham/xDrip-plus l10n_master7 and final merging to xDrip by jamorham) and link to the Crowdin project and manual.
evidence_quote: The PR should briefly describe the translation process (Crowdin account, translation, approval, automatic merging to https://github.com/jamorham/xDrip-plus/tree/l10n_master7 and final merging to xDrip by jamorham) and link to the Crowdin project and Crowdin manual.
